nodes.description: Immutable burn address constant receiving swapped NFTs and WET tokens.
Constant address of the WET ERC20 used to pay the swap cost.
Constant address of the Waifusion NFT contract used for minting, withdrawal and ownership transfer.
Hard cap (16384) on waifu IDs accepted into the dungeon.
Maximum number of waifus burnable in a single swap commit.
Owner-settable ether price per waifu purchased via commitBuyWaifus.
Owner-settable WET token cost per waifu swapped via commitSwapWaifus.
Number of waifus currently stored in the dungeon; index for writes and modulo for reveals.
Monotonic nonce mixed into the reveal randomness seed.
Mapping of committer address to Commit{block, amount} used by the commit/reveal scheme.
Mapping from dungeon index to Waifu{nftContract, waifuID} storage.
Ownable owner address checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
ERC721 receive hook; only accepts funneled NFTs from WAIFUSION and registers them in the dungeon.
Payable commit to buy num waifus at buyCost ether each.
Burns caller NFTs and WET tokens then commits a random swap of the same count.
Reveals committed waifus by transferring them to the caller then cleaning up dungeon storage.
Owner-only funnel of the maximum remaining waifus (up to 20) from Waifusion into the dungeon.
Owner-only withdraw from Waifusion then mint num NFTs for the dungeon.
Owner-only arbitrary ERC721 deposit into the dungeon storage.
Owner-only transfer of the full contract ether balance to the caller.
Owner-only call to Waifusion.withdraw() to pull ether from the NFT contract.
Owner-only transfer of the Waifusion contract ownership.
Owner-only setter for buyCost.
Owner-only setter for swapCost.
Internal commit recorder validating cooldown and writing the Commit struct.
Internal reveal that validates the commit window, derives pseudo-random indices from blockhash and updates revealNonce.
Fallback receive function accepting plain ether transfers.
Constructor initialising the Ownable state.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, commit records, withdrawal recipient and NFT delivery.
IERC721.safeTransferFrom(address(this), msg.sender, waifuID) executed before dungeon bookkeeping is updated.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(balance) forwarding the entire contract balance.
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom of WET tokens to the burn address, an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
IERC721.transferFrom(msg.sender, BURN_ADDR, _ids[i]) burning user-supplied token IDs.
IWaifusion.mintNFT{value: num * nftPrice}(num) external payable call whose price is read from the callee.
Randomness derived from blockhash(commit.block + 1) and revealNonce, influenceable by miners/validators.
IERC721.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), nftID) on an owner-supplied arbitrary NFT contract.
IWaifusion(WAIFUSION).withdraw() external call pulling funds from the NFT contract.
IWaifusion(WAIFUSION).transferOwnership(newOwner) external call handing over control of the NFT contract.
Operator address argument of the ERC721 receive hook, required to equal address(this).
Source address argument of the ERC721 receive hook.
Incoming token ID validated against MAX_NFT_SUPPLY and stored in the dungeon.
Unused calldata payload of the ERC721 receive hook.
Number of waifus the caller commits to buy, multiplied by buyCost.
Array of caller-owned NFT IDs to burn in the swap commit.
Number of NFTs to mint from Waifusion into the dungeon.
Arbitrary ERC721 contract address supplied by the owner.
Token ID deposited by the owner, truncated to uint64 when stored.
New owner address forwarded to the Waifusion contract.
New ether price per waifu.
New WET token price per swapped waifu.
Amount of waifus recorded in the caller commit.
Length of _ids, bounded by MAX_SWAP and waifuCount.
Cached BURN_ADDR used as transfer destination.
Cached WAIFUSION address used for ERC721 transfers.
Loop index over the burned token ID array.
Array of dungeon indices returned by _revealRandomWaifus.
Waifu struct copied from storage before the outgoing transfer.
Loop index used for both transfer and swap-and-pop passes.
Cached waifuCount used in the swap-and-pop cleanup.
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY minus Waifusion totalSupply.
Mint amount capped at 20, forwarded to funnelWaifus.
Price read from IWaifusion.getNFTPrice() and multiplied by num for msg.value.
Memory copy of the caller's Commit used for window validation.
blockhash(commit.block + 1) mixing source for the reveal seed.
Sequence of consecutive dungeon indices generated for the commit amount.
Cached waifuCount used as the modulo bound for random indices.
Pseudo-random index derived from keccak256(revealNonce, revealHash) modulo waifuCount.
Loop index filling the randomIDs array.
Full contract ether balance forwarded to the owner.
block.number cached and stored as the commit block.

edges.reason: onERC721Received reads the WAIFUSION constant to authorise the funnel call.
msg.sender must equal the WAIFUSION constant, gating who may inject NFTs.
tokenId parameter is written into waifusInDungeon as uint64.
tokenId parameter is compared against MAX_NFT_SUPPLY.
onERC721Received increments waifuCount after storing the waifu.
onERC721Received writes the Waifu struct into the dungeon mapping.
operator parameter is constrained to be address(this).
from parameter is part of the ERC721 receive hook signature.
num parameter drives the purchase amount and value check.
commitBuyWaifus reads buyCost to compute the required msg.value.
num * buyCost multiplication must equal msg.value without overflow.
commitBuyWaifus delegates the commit bookkeeping to _commitRandomWaifus.
num is forwarded as the committed waifu amount.
commits[msg.sender] is written, keyed by the caller.
_commitRandomWaifus stores block and amount into the commits mapping.
block.number is cached in the currentBlock local variable.
num parameter is required to be greater than zero before committing.
_ids calldata array is the swap input.
amountToSwap is derived from _ids.length.
commitSwapWaifus reads swapCost to size the WET payment.
WET_TOKEN constant is used as the token being transferred.
BURN_ADDR constant is the destination for burned assets.
WAIFUSION constant is the ERC721 contract whose tokens are burned.
commitSwapWaifus performs an external SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom call before state updates.
A malicious WET token contract can re-enter commitSwapWaifus through the transfer hook.
commitSwapWaifus calls ERC721 transferFrom on an external contract.
_ids[i] is used as the tokenId for the burn transfer.
commitSwapWaifus commits the swap count via _commitRandomWaifus.
amountToSwap is passed as the commit amount.
revealWaifus calls _revealRandomWaifus to obtain indices.
_revealRandomWaifus returns the computed randomIDs array.
revealWaifus makes an external safeTransferFrom call to the caller.
The ERC721 receiver callback can re-enter revealWaifus before waifuCount and storage are cleaned up.
revealWaifus decrements waifuCount during swap-and-pop cleanup.
revealWaifus reads and deletes entries of waifusInDungeon.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external NFT transfer and therefore the callback target.
revealWaifus delivers the revealed NFT to msg.sender.
_revealRandomWaifus reads and resets commits[msg.sender].
The commit lookup is keyed by msg.sender.
waifuCount is used as the modulo bound for index generation.
revealNonce is incremented after each reveal.
_revealRandomWaifus derives its seed from blockhash, a validator-influenceable value.
randomIndex is computed from the blockhash-derived seed, letting block producers bias outcomes.
The randomIDs array is populated inside _revealRandomWaifus.
randomIndex is initialised and iterated modulo _waifuCount.
funnelMaxWaifus is protected by the onlyOwner modifier comparing msg.sender to the owner.
funnelMaxWaifus queries IWaifusion(WAIFUSION).totalSupply().
MAX_NFT_SUPPLY is used to size the remaining supply.
remainingWaifus is computed as MAX_NFT_SUPPLY minus totalSupply.
funnelMaxWaifus forwards the computed amount to funnelWaifus.
waifusToMint is passed as the funnel amount.
funnelWaifus is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
funnelWaifus pulls ether via withdrawFromWaifusion before minting.
funnelWaifus reads the NFT price from the Waifusion contract.
nftPrice local variable stores the price read from the callee.
funnelWaifus performs an external payable mintNFT call.
num parameter determines how many NFTs are minted.
num * nftPrice computes the ether value attached to the mint call.
num parameter bounds the funnel batch size.
addNFTToDungeon is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
addNFTToDungeon pulls the NFT with an external transferFrom call.
nftContract parameter is the arbitrary target of the transferFrom call.
nftID parameter is the token moved into the contract.
addNFTToDungeon stores the Waifu struct at the current waifuCount index.
addNFTToDungeon increments waifuCount.
nftID is truncated to uint64 before being written to storage.
withdraw is restricted by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
The stored _owner is compared with the caller by the onlyOwner modifier.
withdraw sends the whole balance with an external value transfer.
msg.sender is the beneficiary of the ether transfer.
The cached balance local is the amount transferred.
withdrawFromWaifusion is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
withdrawFromWaifusion performs an external call into the Waifusion contract.
The WAIFUSION constant is the callee address.
setWaifusionOwner is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setWaifusionOwner performs an external ownership transfer call.
newOwner parameter is forwarded as the new Waifusion owner.
setBuyCost is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setBuyCost writes the buyCost state variable.
newBuyCost parameter becomes the new buyCost value.
setSwapCost is guarded by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setSwapCost writes the swapCost state variable.
newSwapCost parameter becomes the new swapCost value.

Loop index used for both the external transfers and the cleanup pass.
